subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Their teacher explained open-source work.”?
options: Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions.
She also discussed problems: changing wind, noise concerns, bird safety, and where power lines should go.
It also started teaching people how to use e-books on their phones and tablets.
Sharing designs can help more people solve problems, but it also requires testing, safety checks, and responsible use.
